name: dsh-workspace-activity-sort
description: Sidebar Workspace auto-sort by session activity: the sidebar's Workspace group order IS the Workspace registry's durable display order, so a Host-only plugin keeps the most recently active Workspace on top. On every user message the Host emits api-session/activity; the plugin resolves that Session's owning Workspace from the registry's own session membership and fronts it with the registry's insertBefore (DOM insertBefore semantics). A newly created Session has no Workspace membership yet at session/created time, so it is remembered and fronted once the workspace-table write accounts for it. Nothing is patched in the UI and no activity is stored: the browser follows the resulting order through the workspace controller's follow() stream. Drags, renames, and other Workspace edits are left alone until the next session activity.
